label: D1 after a reward, early in the episode, before an upcoming a2 choice
explanation: Fires only at D1 and essentially only when the reward input is 1 (99.5% of activations, all of the mass). Rewarded D1 alone is far too broad (precision 0.17). Activity drops off sharply with episode time: rate about 10% on trials 0-29, about 1% from trial 40 on. It is also biased toward the agent then choosing a2 (choice logit leaning a2, good = S2, low_first episodes), and it sits in a narrow band of the value head (7.54-7.73). The recorded predicate uses the upcoming GO action, which is the agent own computed choice, not a random outcome; the closest observed-only predicate, (phase == D1) & (in_rew == 1) & (ep_trial < 40), gets dev F1 0.51 with mass recall 0.80. Adding action == 2 raises dev F1 to 0.70 but loses mass, because many of the strongest activations are in early high_first episodes before a1 choices. Never fires at GO or D2, on unrewarded D1, or on D1 fixation errors. Magnitude is largest in early-episode windows; beyond that I did not find a clean magnitude driver, so it probably reflects a slowly drifting episode-level state rather than a crisp task variable.
